cs.t: So I got Sony super-duper 4k HDR with some chip that makes the colors better. I hook up my Sony ps4 to it. Every time a game launches, the tv fully shuts off. Not standby mode, fully shuts off, requiring a reboot through that stupid android tv screen. Good job, Sony.
cs.th: In an Era of ‘Smart’ Things, Sometimes Dumb Stuff Is Better
